versions.changelog:
Initial release of lovense-cli.

- Control Lovense toys (e.g. Lush, Hush, Nora, Solace) locally from the command line using Python stdlib only.
- No dependencies, cloud, or API keys required; works via Game Mode on the Lovense app (LAN only).
- Supports commands for discovery, vibrate, preset patterns, custom patterns, raw actions, and stop.
- Includes safety rules for consent, safe use, and immediate stop command for agents.
- Setup and command details provided for easy, secure operation on the local network.
